name: fixed-app-navigation
goal: The shared app navigation stays at the viewport top while desktop, tablet and phone catalogs scroll, preserving responsive content clearance and working links

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The shared NavBar scrolls away. A 24-component fixture must retain the full responsive bar at viewport y=0 after scrolling 1000px, keep initial content below it and preserve working category navigation at 1440, 920 and 390px.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: TAKE_SCREENSHOT=true SCREENSHOT_LABEL=before bun run --cwd packages/desktop test:e2e fixed-navigation.spec.ts: all three tests fail at nav y=-1000 versus 0. Before screenshots saved and desktop pixels inspected.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Pinned the existing shared topbar at top:0 with sticky positioning, a solid matching background and z-index 30. Normal flow retains the full responsive header height without fixed spacer guesses or duplicate navigation.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: The same three scrolling regressions pass at 1440, 920 and 390px; nav y stays 0 after 1000px scroll, initial content clearance and category navigation pass. All 18 affected browser tests pass; fresh desktop/mobile after screenshots inspected.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
